summary: Preview durable thread histories in the existing fleet-mid-refactor TUI demo world

replay.detail: Demo fixtures do not write or replay durable claims. Thread timelines preserve their supplied server order even when timestamps are skewed.

schema.detail: No stored claim schema changes. The optional attention scenario inventory carries existing ThreadSummary and ThreadTimelineEvent wire values.

rules.detail: All demo thread windows use default read-only ThreadAccess. No thread mutation transport or synthetic authority is introduced.

compatibility.detail: The existing fleet-mid-refactor attention slice includes optional topic_threads with strict wire decoding and timestamp rebasing. Slices without the inventory remain supported.

downtime.detail: This preview does not connect to or restart a daemon.

manual.detail: Run fractal tui --demo and open the worker typecheck Inbox item for fixture/preliminary open, closed, multiple-thread and read-only histories. Writable composer and lifecycle controls require the live mutation receipt driver and are not shown.

recovery.detail: Quit the demo; no daemon state, pairings or conversation history is changed.
